l1.text: Here's how NeuroPro is doing this year, January through September.

l2.text: Visits are up seventy-eight percent, from three hundred forty a month in January to about six hundred five in September. Our busiest month yet.

l3.text: We've served about a thousand and ten patients. Therapy is the base, and testing more than doubled in August.

l4.text: From February through August, we booked one point zero one million dollars, and kept forty-nine cents of every dollar. In August, it was fifty-seven.

l5.text: Each visit now brings in three hundred twenty-four dollars, and costs one thirty-nine to deliver.

l6.text: But cash is lagging. Seven hundred fifty-nine thousand has come in. Liens and unpaid invoices hold most of the rest.

l7.text: Three things need action now. Submit the injury backlog. Name an owner for lien collections. And work the rejected insurance claims.

l8.text: The team is scaling, too. Counselor visits more than doubled, and Doctor Doran's share of visits is down from fifty-seven percent to thirty-nine.

l9.text: And with nine hundred ninety-nine visits already booked for the fourth quarter, we're set up for a strong finish.
